question: Where was the 8th India Water Week 2024 held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 8th India Water Week 2024 was held in **New Delhi**, the capital city of India.
 
• India Water Week is a biennial event organized by the Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India.
 
• The event focuses on the water-related issues and aims to promote sustainable water management practices.
 
• The conference brings together experts, policymakers, and stakeholders from around the globe to discuss and deliberate on water conservation and management strategies.
 
• The theme for the 2024 event was "Water Security for Sustainable Development and Equity".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Jal Shakti**

 
 
• The Ministry of Jal Shakti was formed in May 2019 by merging the Ministry of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation and the Ministry of Drinking Water and Sanitation.
 
• It focuses on the management of water resources and sanitation across the country.
 
• Key initiatives include the Jal Jeevan Mission and the Namami Gange Programme.
 
 
 
• **Jal Jeevan Mission**
 
 
• Launched in 2019, it aims to provide safe and adequate drinking water through individual household tap connections by 2024 to all rural households.
 
• The mission emphasizes community involvement and sustainable water management.
 
 
 
• **Namami Gange Programme**
 
 
• It is an integrated conservation mission, approved as a 'Flagship Programme' by the Union Government in June 2014.
 
• The objective is to clean and rejuvenate the Ganga River.
 
• The programme involves various initiatives such as sewage treatment, river surface cleaning, and afforestation.
 
 
 
• **Water Conservation Techniques**
 
 
• Rainwater Harvesting: Collecting and storing rainwater for reuse before it reaches the aquifer.
 
• Drip Irrigation: An efficient irrigation method that saves water by allowing water to drip slowly to the roots of plants.
 
• Reuse and Recycling: Treating wastewater to make it usable again for various purposes.
